source.html:
Chicken Florentine Pasta
 
Save Print
Author: The Pioneer Woman
Recipe type: Dinner
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • 1 Package(s) campanelle or penne regate pasta, cooked
  • 2 chicken breast
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) butter
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) extra virgin olive oil
  • 4 Clove(s) garlic pressed with knife and minced
  • ¾ Cup(s) dry white wine
  • ¾ Cup(s) chicken broth
  • 1 fresh spinach (or one bag)
  • 2 Cup(s) Grape tomatoes-cut in half
  • 4 Ounce(s) grated parmesan cheese
Instructions
  1. Cook pasta. Drain and set aside.
  2. Cut chicken into thin chunks. Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides. Heat butter and oil in a large skillet. Add chicken and cook on both sides. Remove chicken from skillet.
  3. Add garlic and cook about 30 seconds. Add wine and broth and 2 tablespoons flour and cook until reduced by half. Add spinach and tomatoes and chicken and stir until spinach is cooked down. Remove from heat.
  4. Add pasta and Parmesan cheese and stir to combine.
  5. Can also use bacon chunks instead of chicken.
